notes: life-hub uses the lens-only model for the four personas (01-01, 03-02, 05-05, 05-06): no body copy in the consumer. CAUGHT UP 2026-08-27 (#978), and every field below was measured against the consumer's own live .claude/settings.json via the GitHub API rather than taken from the report. Three things were wrong here at once. (1) The two plugin ids were still the pre-August-3 names 'specialists@' and 'specialists-lifehub@'; they are 'team-alpha@' and 'team-lifehub@' in the live file, so this repo had been holding the retired names for 24 days after the consumer migrated. (2) 'contributing-davekjohn@claude-code-specialists' is enabled there and was not registered here AT ALL -- the blind spot xoxowildhearts.json's own notes document: check-connectors loops over the plugins THIS manifest lists, so an enabled plugin missing from that array is invisible to the version check and cannot be reported as drifted whatever version they run. It ships no agents/, hence the deliberately empty extension list -- the same measured answer, and the same wording, as the other four manifests. (3) A fourth plugin is enabled there that this marketplace does not publish, 'figma@claude-plugins-official'; deliberately NOT registered, because this register is the register of THIS marketplace's consumers and an id from another marketplace would resolve to nothing here for a reason that is not a defect. THE EXTENSION LISTS WERE VERIFIED RATHER THAN CARRIED OVER, because renaming an id changes what the check actually does: while the id was retired the check reported [INFO] and skipped the whole block, so the lists below had gone 24 days without being read. Measured: 24 lens files under .claude/specialists/lenses/, against 19 + 5 registered here -- an exact match, which is why this rename makes nothing red. Timing per the doctrine in connectors/README.md: the new id is written only AFTER the consumer has migrated, and all of them had.
